environment.description: Migration script deployed on ECS Fargate task in an isolated private subnet (subnet-0a3f8e2c) within VPC vpc-04d91b7a. The subnet route table (rtb-0ef12ca8) contains only a local route (10.0.48.0/20 -> local) with no NAT gateway, no VPC endpoint for S3/SSM, and no transit gateway attachment. The only reachable endpoint is the RDS instance via its security group (sg-0b4c91de) which permits inbound 5432 from the task security group (sg-0f7a23bc). DNS resolution is provided by Route53 Resolver inbound endpoint for the RDS CNAME only. The task execution role (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/MigrationTaskExec) has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/NoNetworkModify) that denies ec2:CreateRoute, ec2:CreateNatGateway, ec2:CreateVpcEndpoint, and ec2:AttachInternetGateway.

config.network: Private subnet subnet-0a3f8e2c in VPC vpc-04d91b7a, route table rtb-0ef12ca8 with ONLY local route 10.0.48.0/20
config.nat_gateway: NONE - no NAT gateway in any subnet of this VPC
config.security_group_task: sg-0f7a23bc: egress only to sg-0b4c91de on port 5432
config.security_group_rds: sg-0b4c91de: ingress from sg-0f7a23bc on port 5432 only
config.dns: Route53 Resolver inbound endpoint resolves only the RDS CNAME (migration-db.internal.corp)
config.iam_permissions_boundary: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/NoNetworkModify denies ec2:Create*, ec2:Attach*, ec2:Modify* on network resources
config.container: ECS Fargate, no exec access, no SSH, awslogs driver to CloudWatch only via Fargate platform networking
